title: Slush Helsinki
metaDescription: Slush Helsinki: verified dates, location and OneSliders event context for Tech Events.

overview.about: Slush is Europe's most influential startup event, held each November in a deliberately dark, high-energy Helsinki venue. Founder-focused and student-run, it connects early-stage founders with investors from around the world and has helped define the Nordic startup scene.
overview.nextEvent: The next Slush is held in November in Helsinki. It pairs a main-stage programme with thousands of curated founder-investor meetings, and its wintry, atmospheric staging has become its trademark.
